contents.text: TRUTH IN CONTEXT BUILDS A DEEPER TOMORROW
REAL GAMES. REAL QUESTIONS. A MORE INFORMED WORLD.

lines: Flowers is day-to-day, Lane is on injured reserve.
Sunday turns Baltimore's receiver depth into a live test.

header.text: IF FLOWERS CANNOT CARRY THE SAME WORKLOAD, WHERE DO THE OPPORTUNITIES GO?

sub_cards.title: FLOWERS LIMITED
sub_cards.body: Which routes and targets are redistributed?

Cup present, mark square to camera, all three copy lines legible, no club or sponsor mark.
Field runs left-to-right ascending; yard numerals descend toward the right edge; no mirroring.
Player set is exactly 8 figures in the declared roles; no logos or nameplates on uniforms.
Exactly three gold route arrows with the three locked labels, verbatim, in the locked positions.
Passing-window ellipse present, labelled, beneath the arrows in z-order.
Footer has exactly three cells in the locked order; QR block present with quiet zone intact.
QR scans on a phone camera and resolves to asset.explore_url.
Claim Status panel carries all three tiers with verbatim glosses.
Every headline, deck, subdeck, panel and colophon string matches this packet verbatim, including punctuation and the en dash in '41–23'.
No item in exclusions.forbidden appears anywhere on the page.
Body copy is fully legible with no AI text garbling at 100% canvas.
